verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a public REST or GraphQL API for driving Snyk programmatically, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path on docs.snyk.io. The pack does document a CLI (snyk-gh-1, snyk-probe-4) and a local MCP server (snyk-docs-28), but these are separate interfaces, not a documented public API. Confidence is medium rather than high because the probe only checked the docs domain, so absence there does not prove no API exists.
